entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Fix up resolution logic for property summaries #63201
    10.0-rc1
  • Blazor MSAL RedirectToLogin.razor out of date #63199
  • Perf regression: fortunes, fortunes #63198
  • Perf improvement: antiforgery-generation #63197
  • [Blazor] Persist component enhanced navigation state issue on components added or components updated without key #63193
    10.0-rc1
  • Consider obsoleting Bootstrap 4 support in the default Identity UI package #63191
  • [AspNetCore .NET 9] Headers lost when HttpContext is cleared in ExceptionHandlerMiddlewareImpl #63187
  • [Blazor] Incorrectly computed URL for JSInitializers without base URL #63184
    Backlog
  • API proposal for EnforceServerCultureOnClient #63183
  • API Suggestion: Add HttpSys wrapper interface for HttpQueryRequestProperty Windows API #63181

Closed

  • [Validation] Support embedded validatabletypeattribute #63141
    10.0-rc1
  • Error in RequestDelegateGenerator generated code (assigns int to enum) #62910
    10.0-rc1
  • MapStaticAssets crashes entire app due inconsistent appsettings #62444
  • The runtime<->aspnetcore shared src is out of sync #18943
  • OpenAPI throws error MSB3073 and code 11 #63170
  • Interactive WebAssembly throws on page reload #63009
    10.0-rc1
  • Reloading the InteractiveServer page consecutively throws circuit shutdown error #62860
    10.0-rc1
  • [API review] IMemoryPoolFactory options #63085
    10.0-rc1
  • [API Proposal]: PinnedBlockMemoryPool metrics #61594
  • Azure Web App Autoscale Instances can't connect to Redis for SignalR - StackExchangeRedis #51740
  • (SignalR): Support custom output formatter #55546
  • donet 8 Blazor Interactive Server does not route to Razor Pages (MVC) #53979
  • Visual Studio 17.10.6 is causing runtime error - typeError: Promise constructor cannot be invoked without "new" #57571
  • Critical Bug: Blazor Server – SignalR NullReferenceException when closing modal and updating QuickGrid #62858
  • Newline handling different on linux x64 and linux aarch64 #57880
  • [XmlCommentGenerator] AddOpenApi cannot recognize the entry assembly #62941

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix CustomElements package including JavaScript config files as Content #63200
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Test WebApplicationBuilder with WebApplicationFactory #63196
    area-mvc
  • Send Keep-Alive Ping Immediately When Previous Ping Is Overdue #63195
    area-signalr, community-contribution
  • Fix Blazor persistent component state restoration for components without keys and add E2E test coverage #63194
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Add [Obsolete] attribute to Bootstrap 4 support in Identity UI #63192
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Fix JSInitializer URL computation for base URLs with query parameters #63185
    Attention: Shared Code Modified

Merged

  • [Validation] Support generated `ValidatableTypeAttribute` for Blazor #63115
    area-infrastructure, 10.0-rc1
  • Fix handling of enum default values in RDF and RDG #63086
    area-networking, 10.0-rc1
  • [main] (deps): Bump dotnet/arcade from 40693ae2ee51e447f6ca96d07bc1ba779dcb9b9c to 7c0434b26153965459a8d7968f18cf7c0a2cf463 #63186
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
  • Sync shared code from runtime #63169
    area-runtime, 10.0-rc1

Updated

  • Server memory pool metrics updates #63032
    area-networking
  • Fix ErrorBoundary not rendering ErrorContent when multiple exceptions occur #63145
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • OpenAPI: Apply descriptions from [Description] to the schema reference instead of the actual schema for properties #63177
    area-mvc, community-contribution, feature-openapi
  • Add SkipValidationAttribute to Microsoft.Extensions.Validation #63103
    area-infrastructure
  • OpenAPI: merge multiple body content types into one operation #61401
    area-mvc, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • Add passkey count and name length limits #62979
    area-blazor
  • Fix OpenAPI schema generation for FileContentResult to use binary format #63180
    area-mvc, community-contribution, feature-openapi, pr: pending author input
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #63109
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
  • [OpenApi] Test schema reference validity #63095
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal
  • Support processing XML comments on [AsParameters] parameter #63166
    feature-openapi, area-minimal
  • [Blazor] Add version-based cache busting to dotnet.js import statements #63164
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Added Culture persistence between Client and Server #63144
    area-blazor, 10.0-rc1
  • Include a warning about host spoofing in xml #63174
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Changed css classes assignment in RenderPlaceholderRow #62709
    area-blazor
